issue.title: test_no_ref_prefix_dispatch fails: jump engine dispatches on ref: prefix in _link_follow_targets.py and artifacts_navigation.py
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/ace/tui/artifacts_contract/test_no_ref_prefix_dispatch.py::test_behavioral_modules_do_not_dispatch_on_ref_prefix`

Deterministic contract failure on master `1230ed8da`. It fails in the full scoped lane and
alone (`pytest -n0` on the single node), with the working tree's sase-170 landing edits
unrelated to the flagged files.

Offenders (behavioral `ref:` pane-id prefix dispatch that the Artifacts contract forbids):

- `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/_link_follow_targets.py:165` — `if not pane_id.startswith("ref:"):`
- `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/artifacts_navigation.py:112` — `target_pane.startswith("ref:")`
- `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/artifacts_navigation.py:146` — `pane_key.startswith("ref:")`

Both were introduced by `e3c2a7788` (sase-16t.8, "one engine for every jump"). The
sase-16y land agent relayed this as a DISCOVERED ISSUE on sase-16t (note #3) three
minutes after sase-16t had already closed, and the sase-16t landing commit `813f42a53`
repaired the sibling `link_trail` and `query_profile_reference` failures but not this one,
so nobody owns it now.

Fix: route these branches through the declared Artifacts tab contract API
(`_artifact_tab_contract.py` / `_artifact_tab_model.py` helpers that already parse the
`ref:<kind>` encoding) instead of string-prefix dispatch. Only extend `_ALLOWLIST` if a
line is genuinely identity parsing rather than pane dispatch, with a comment saying why.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Static source scan; fails identically in the full lane and alone on an unchanged tree because three committed lines match the forbidden ref: dispatch regex.

payload.description: Closed epic whose phase sase-16t.8 (e3c2a7788) introduced the offending ref: dispatch; its note #3 relays this failure

Reproduced by sase-16z.9 land agent at master ee6f7c064 (reported by sase-16z.9.3): offenders include actions/artifacts_navigation.py and the _link_follow_targets.py module.
